title: OPLoRA: Orthogonal Projection LoRA Prevents Catastrophic Forgetting during Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2510.13003v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient fine-tuning of large language models but suffers from catastrophic forgetting when learned updates interfere with the dominant singular directions that encode essential pre-trained knowledge. We propose Orthogonal Projection LoRA (OPLoRA), a theoretically grounded approach that prevents this interference through double-sided orthogonal projections. By decomposing frozen weights via SVD, OPLoRA constrains LoRA updates to lie entirely within the orthogonal complement of the top-$k$ singular subspace using projections $P_L = I - U_k U_k^\top$ and $P_R = I - V_k V_k^\top$. We prove that this construction exactly preserves the top-$k$ singular triples, providing mathematical guarantees for knowledge retention. translated_title: OPLoRA：通过正交投影LoRA防止参数高效微调中的灾难性遗忘
translated_abstract: 低秩适配能够对大语言模型进行高效微调，但当学习到的更新与编码关键预训练知识的主奇异方向发生干扰时，会产生灾难性遗忘问题。我们提出了正交投影LoRA（OPLoRA），这是一种具有理论基础的方法，通过双侧正交投影来防止这种干扰。通过对冻结权重进行奇异值分解（SVD），OPLoRA利用投影 P_L = I - U_k U_k^T 和 P_R = I - V_k V_k^T，将LoRA更新完全约束在前k个奇异子空间的正交补空间内。我们证明了这种构造能够精确保持前k个奇异三元组，为知识保留提供了数学保证。为了量化子空间干扰，我们引入了度量指标 ρ_k，用于衡量更新与主导方向的对齐程度。在常识推理、数学等任务上的大量实验……
tldr: OPLoRA通过双侧正交投影将LoRA更新约束在冻结权重前k个奇异子空间的正交补空间内，以数学保证的方式精确保留预训练知识，从而防止微调过程中的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: OPLoRA constrains LoRA updates to lie entirely in the orthogonal complement of the top-k singular subspace via double-sided orthogonal projections, providing mathematical guarantees that preserve pre-trained knowledge and prevent catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.
